## Black Alert
[bold][color=#ffffff]Quote[/color][/bold]
"There is an immediate threat to the sector beyond the control of security personnel."
Black Alert indicates an active, immediate threat that requires maximum response beyond the capabilities of station security.
### Criteria for Declaring Black Alert
Black Alert should be under the following cirtiera:
- Red Alert criteria PLUS Security is unable to handle the threat themselves.
Black Alert [bold]should not be treated as a permanent state.[/bold] It must be lifted as soon as the immediate threat is neutralized or contained. Leaving the station at Black Alert without active justification is a misuse of authority.
### What Changes on Black Alert
All Red Alert changes remain in effect, plus:
[bold]C3 Equipment[/bold] All personnel are explicilty permitted to deploy class three contraband on station.
[bold]Commanded Obedience[/bold] Obedience to directives by command and security is mandatory. Failure to obey commands may result in death.
Crew shall: - Set suit sensors to tracking mode at all times. - Contribute towards defense of the station's critical assets. - Visibly arm themselves.
